hints.registryCleanup: Removes references to programs that no longer exist — stale uninstall entries, broken file associations, and orphaned paths. These accumulate over time and are safe to clean.
hints.security: Checks critical Windows security settings like UAC, Defender, firewall, and RDP. Fixing these hardens your system against common attacks.
hints.performance: Identifies services like SysMain (Superfetch) that may slow boot times or waste resources on systems with SSDs.
hints.network: LLMNR and WPAD are legacy name-resolution protocols commonly exploited for man-in-the-middle attacks. Disabling them is recommended unless your network specifically requires them.
hints.services: Print Spooler and Fax are unnecessary on most PCs and have had critical security vulnerabilities (e.g., PrintNightmare). Safe to disable unless you use a physical printer or fax.
hints.scheduledTasks: Cleans up orphaned scheduled tasks, telemetry collectors, and third-party updaters running in the background. Review tasks you don't recognize before removing.
hints.riskLow: Low risk — easily reversible and won't affect system stability.
hints.riskMedium: Medium risk — may require a reboot. A backup is created before changes.
hints.riskHigh: High risk — affects core system behavior. Review carefully before applying.
hints.fixAction: "Fix" modifies or removes the selected registry entries. A .reg backup is created first so you can undo changes if needed.
